surface.note: The structural ramp, not a palette. Light: surface #f8f6f2, surface-low #f1eee8, surface-mid #eae6df, surface-high #e2ded6, surface-bright #ffffff. Dark: #131315, #1a1a1d, #202024, #28282d, #34343a.

inverse-surface.note: Snackbar only. The one place the theme flips.

display.purpose: One sentence per screen, first in the column. 44px at >=840px. Never two on a page.

headline.purpose: The Up-next title inside the slab; Progress numbers set as a sentence. 30px at >=840px; the single most important title also takes .focal (36px, desktop only).

headline-sm.purpose: Sheet titles, result titles, empty and error state titles.

title-sm.purpose: The quiet label above a list: Today, In progress, Backlog.

body-lg.purpose: The coach sentence and the takeaway. The only copy written to be read slowly.

meta.purpose: The facts line under a title: category, minutes, relevance dots, relative time. --on-surface-3.

section-title.purpose: A quiet label inside a form group. Sentence case, never uppercased.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Applied to fixed elements that overlap scrolling content: the FAB, the live session pill, the snackbar, and the rail FAB on hover. Never on slabs, rows, inputs, chips, sheets, navbar or rail.

shadows.name: focus-ring-inset
shadows.purpose: Focused text input. Preserves the capsule shape where an outline would not.

shadows.name: switch-track-off
shadows.purpose: The off-state switch track. The only other stroke-like treatment in the build; removed entirely when on.

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Full-bleed behind a sheet or dialog. No blur, no backdrop-filter anywhere in the system.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: CSS transforms: switch thumb, progress dots, chevron rotation.

motion.name: out
motion.purpose: Material emphasised-decelerate. Everything that enters or changes colour: pills, chips, rows, ripple, shimmer.

motion.name: js-spring
motion.purpose: The default motion/react transition: layout, the shared-layoutId nav indicator, taps, the snackbar, the live pill.

motion.name: js-springSoft
motion.purpose: The gentler spring, exported from ui.tsx as the softer option.

motion.name: js-easeOut
motion.purpose: Content that fades in: progress bars, step rows, the welcome paragraph.

motion.name: page-entrance
motion.value: opacity 0->1, y 10->0 over 360ms on the out curve
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance per page. Sections inside do not animate separately.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: The only nested motion allowed: list rows entering with the rise variant (opacity + 10px).

motion.name: ripple
motion.value: scale(0) -> scale(2.6), opacity 0.16 -> 0 over 520ms on the out curve
motion.purpose: Injected at the click point on every pill; removed after 560ms.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: The live-session dot. 1.2s on the active step dot in the add sheet.

motion.name: sheet-spring
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet slide and desktop dialog scale.

motion.name: drag-to-dismiss
motion.purpose: The bottom sheet's dismissal threshold. Disabled on desktop and under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: The only breakpoint in the system. Flips navbar to rail, bottom sheet to centred dialog, chip scroller to wrapping set, and steps display/headline up one size.

breakpoints.name: coarse-pointer
breakpoints.purpose: Not a width query. Grows chips to 40px, .pill-sm to 44px, rows to 72px so every control clears 44px on touch.

layout.name: content-max
layout.purpose: The single centred column. There is no grid anywhere in the build.

layout.name: gutter
layout.purpose: Horizontal page inset on phone; 40px (--s-8) on desktop.

layout.name: nav-h
layout.purpose: Bottom navigation bar height; every fixed element composes with it plus --safe-bottom.

layout.name: titlebar-h
layout.purpose: 0 by default; promoted to 36px by data-frameless="true" on <html> in the Tauri desktop window.

layout.name: section-gap
layout.purpose: The gap between every section of a page.

components.name: Filled Pill
components.description: The single primary action per screen: Start, Analyze and save, Done. A sage capsule that compresses on press and ripples from the touch point.
components.css: .ds-pill { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font, "Figtree Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1), color 150ms, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), opacity 150ms; } .ds-pill::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: currentColor; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-pill:active::after { opacity: 0.1; } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #2f6a52); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pill-filled { background: var(--primary, #2f6a52); color: var(--on-primary, #ffffff); }

components.name: Tonal Pill
components.description: The default button. A surface-high capsule that steps one tone brighter on hover.
components.css: .ds-pill { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font, "Figtree Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1), transform 120ms; } .ds-pill-tonal { background: var(--surface-high, #e2ded6); color: var(--on-surface, #1c1b1a); } .ds-pill-tonal:hover { background: var(--surface-bright, #ffffff); } .ds-pill-tonal:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #2f6a52); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Pill
components.description: The secondary action beside a filled pill. Sage label, no fill until hover.
components.css: .ds-pill-text { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #2f6a52); font-family: var(--font, "Figtree Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1); } .ds-pill-text:hover { background: var(--surface-low, #f1eee8); } .ds-pill-text:active { background: var(--surface-mid, #eae6df); } .ds-pill-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #2f6a52); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: The only 10px radius in the system. Selected state swaps to the sage container and prepends a check.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-mid, #eae6df); color: var(--on-surface-2, #57544f); font-family: var(--font, "Figtree Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1), color 150ms, transform 120ms; } .ds-chip:not([data-active="true"]):hover { background: var(--surface-high, #e2ded6); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-chip[data-active="true"] { background: var(--primary-container, #cfe7da); color: var(--on-primary-container, #0f3325); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #2f6a52); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Slab
components.description: The one large surface in the system, and it is not a card: a one-step-lighter patch of the same material with 28px corners, no border and no shadow. Carries the Up-next title, its facts line, the coach sentence and the Start pill.
components.html:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Explained

LLMs   ~12 min

This covers eval pipelines, your weakest area. Twelve minutes well spent before the interview round.
components.css: .ds-slab { background: var(--surface-low, #f1eee8); border-radius: 28px; padding: 24px; font-family: var(--font, "Figtree Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-slab-title { margin: 0; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-weight: 400; color: var(--on-surface, #1c1b1a); } .ds-slab-meta { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--on-surface-3, #67635d); } .ds-slab-body { margin: 14px 0 0; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--on-surface-2, #57544f); } .ds-slab-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 22px; } .ds-pill { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1), transform 120ms; } .ds-pill-filled { background: var(--primary, #2f6a52); color: var(--on-primary, #ffffff); } .ds-pill-filled:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill-text { height: 56px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #2f6a52); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-pill-text:hover { background: var(--surface-mid, #eae6df); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A 52px filled capsule with no border. On focus the fill steps one tone up and a 2px sage inset ring appears, so the capsule shape survives.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font, "Figtree Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--on-surface-2, #57544f); padding-left: 4px; } .ds-input { height: 52px; width: 100%; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-mid, #eae6df); color: var(--on-surface, #1c1b1a); font: inherit; font-size: 15px; transition: background 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--on-surface-3, #67635d); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; background: var(--surface-high, #e2ded6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--primary, #2f6a52) inset; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Four destinations on a surface-low bar with no top border. The active destination carries a 64x32px sage-container indicator pill that slides between destinations via a shared layoutId.
components.html: TodayLibraryProgressSettings
components.css: .ds-navbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); height: 80px; padding: 12px 8px 0; background: var(--surface-low, #f1eee8); font-family: var(--font, "Figtree Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); border-radius: 0; } .ds-dest { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 4px; color: var(--on-surface-2, #57544f); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; } .ds-dest-ind { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 32px; border-radius: 16px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-dest-ind svg { position: relative; } .ds-dest-pill { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--primary-container, #cfe7da); } .ds-dest[data-active="true"] { color: var(--on-surface, #1c1b1a); } .ds-dest[data-active="true"] .ds-dest-ind { color: var(--on-primary-container, #0f3325); } .ds-dest:hover .ds-dest-ind { color: var(--on-surface, #1c1b1a); }

components.name: List Row
components.description: The quiet list you scroll past. Borderless, 64px min height, with an 18px-radius hit area that bleeds 12px past the column so the hover fill reads as a target rather than a box.
components.css: .ds-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: var(--font, "Figtree Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-rowitem { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; text-align: left; width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 18px; min-height: 64px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1), transform 120ms; } .ds-rowitem:hover { background: var(--surface-low, #f1eee8); } .ds-rowitem:active { background: var(--surface-mid, #eae6df); transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-rowitem:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #2f6a52); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-thumb { width: 88px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--surface-mid, #eae6df); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--on-surface-3, #67635d); } .ds-rowitem-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; } .ds-rowitem-title { font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 500; color: var(--on-surface, #1c1b1a); } .ds-rowitem-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--on-surface-3, #67635d); } .ds-dots { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; align-items: center; } .ds-dots i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--on-surface-3, #67635d); opacity: 0.35; } .ds-dots i[data-on="true"] { background: var(--primary, #2f6a52); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Live Session Pill
components.description: The signature component and the reason for the Recorder grammar. A floating surface-bright capsule with a breathing red dot, the item title, a tabular-figure elapsed timer, a stop button and a filled Done pill.
components.css: .ds-live { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--surface-bright, #ffffff); color: var(--on-surface, #1c1b1a); border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 18px; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(28,27,26,0.14), 0 2px 6px rgba(28,27,26,0.08); font-family: var(--font, "Figtree Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); max-width: 520px; } .ds-live-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--error, #b3261e); flex-shrink: 0; animation: ds-breathe 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: scale(0.6); opacity: 0.5; } } .ds-live-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; font: inherit; } .ds-live-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; max-width: 100%; } .ds-live-time { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--on-surface-3, #67635d); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-live-stop { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--on-surface-2, #57544f); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-live-stop:hover { background: var(--surface-low, #f1eee8); } .ds-live-done { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary, #2f6a52); color: var(--on-primary, #ffffff); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms; } .ds-live-done:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: The one inverted surface in the system. Single line, no wrap, springs in from 16px below and auto-dismisses after 2800ms.
components.css: .ds-snackbar { display: inline-block; background: var(--inverse-surface, #2f2e2c); color: var(--inverse-on-surface, #f3f0eb); padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 14px; font-family: var(--font, "Figtree Variable", system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(28,27,26,0.14), 0 2px 6px rgba(28,27,26,0.08); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: A 52x32px track with a 2px inset ring when off and a solid sage fill when on. The thumb scales 0.66 to 1 and translates 20px on the spring curve.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 52px; height: 32px; border: 0; padding: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-high, #e2ded6); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--on-surface-3, #67635d); cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; transition: background 240ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1), box-shadow 240ms; } .ds-switch::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -8px; } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--on-surface-3, #67635d); transform: scale(0.66); transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), background 240ms; } .ds-switch[data-on="true"] { background: var(--primary, #2f6a52); box-shadow: none; } .ds-switch[data-on="true"]::after { transform: translateX(20px) scale(1); background: var(--on-primary, #ffffff); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #2f6a52); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: The only meter in the system: a 4px fully-rounded track on surface-high with a sage fill that animates from zero over 700ms. Today's minutes against the daily target.
components.css: .ds-bar { height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-high, #e2ded6); overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar > i { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary, #2f6a52); transform-origin: left; transition: width 700ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1); }

narrative.overview:
UpWise is the Now Playing screen of a learning habit. The whole interface is one calm tonal sheet with a single sentence set large on it — what to learn now — and one pill to press. Everything below that is a quiet list you scroll past. The system is Material You read through Google's Recorder app: tonal surfaces stepped by lightness rather than divided by lines, generous corner radii, one accent used sparingly, and motion that feels sprung rather than eased.

Density is deliberately low. A screen is a single 680px column of stacked sections separated by 32px of air, never a grid of cards. Type does the hierarchy work: a 40px display line, a 28px headline for the one thing that matters, and everything else at 15px or 13px in a dimmer on-surface tone. Weight is almost entirely regular (400); 500 appears only on labels, pills and row titles. Nothing is bolded for emphasis and nothing is uppercased.

The confirmed anti-reference is the card-grid dashboard: boxed tiles, KPI stat cards, dividing rules, and hairline borders around content. The build refuses all of them — there is exactly one shadow token in the system and it is reserved for things that float above the page. Two platforms share this system unchanged: a Tauri webview in a frameless desktop window and an Android WebView on a Pixel. A single 840px breakpoint is the only thing that differs between them.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal surfaces stepped by lightness; no borders, no dividers, one shadow token
One sage accent (--primary) and one apricot warmth (--warm); nothing else is coloured
Figtree at regular weight, set large — 40px display, 28px headline
28px slabs, 999px pills, 14px thumbnails, 18px row hit areas
One authored entrance per page; spring physics, never linear easing
A single 840px breakpoint flips navbar to rail and bottom sheet to centred dialog

rules.name: The Step, Don't Draw Rule
rules.body: Separation is a change of tone, never a line. A surface that needs to read as distinct moves one step up the ramp (--surface -> --surface-low -> --surface-mid -> --surface-high -> --surface-bright). No border, no border-top, no <hr> appears anywhere in the built stylesheets. If two things need separating and a tone step is wrong, use space instead.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage is the only colour that means "act". Apricot means "warm fact" (streak, growing backlog) and red means "live or wrong". A screen carries one sage moment — the Start pill or the active nav indicator — and nothing competes with it.

rules.name: The Warm-On-Quiet-Surfaces Rule
rules.body: --warm as text is legible on --surface (4.98:1) and --surface-low (4.65:1) only. It drops to 4.32:1 on --surface-mid and 4.01:1 on --surface-high. Warm text lives on the page or in a slab; on higher surfaces use --warm-container with --on-warm-container (9.77:1) instead.

rules.name: The Regular Weight Rule
rules.body: h1-h4 and p are reset to font-weight: 400 globally. Emphasis comes from size, tone and space. Weight 500 is reserved for interactive labels (pills, chips, nav destinations, row titles) and small labels; 600+ appears nowhere.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: Exactly one .display per screen and it is the first thing in the column. If a second idea wants display size, it is a different screen or it is a .headline.

rules.name: The Sentence, Not The Tile Rule
rules.body: Numbers are set as prose inside a .headline, not as KPI tiles — "12-day streak, best 20. 48 things learned." Statistics get a sentence and a colour span; they never get a box.

rules.name: The single-breakpoint rule
rules.body: 840px is the only breakpoint in the system. It flips exactly four things: navbar to rail, bottom sheet to centred dialog, horizontal chip scroller to wrapping chip set, and the display/headline sizes up one step. A second breakpoint is a design failure, not a fix.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this is not part of the page". Slabs, rows, inputs, chips, sheets, the navbar and the rail all carry zero shadow at every state. If an element scrolls with the content, it does not get --shadow-float.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Modality is the only other depth device: .scrim at rgba(0,0,0,0.42) full-bleed behind a sheet. No blur, no backdrop-filter anywhere in the build.

rules.name: The Never-Boxed Rule
rules.body: No element in the system has a border. The only stroke-like treatments are box-shadow: inset on a focused input and on the off-state switch track — both are state feedback, not structure. A "card" in this system is a .slab: a tone step with 28px corners and 24px padding, used once or twice per screen, never as a repeating grid unit.

rules.name: The Squircle Family Rule
rules.body: Square-ish controls take a radius roughly a third of their size — 60px FAB at 20px, 56px rail FAB at 18px, 32px brand mark at 10px — so nothing ever reads as a circle unless it is a true pill.

rules.name: The One Entrance Rule
rules.body: <Page> animates once — opacity 0->1 and y 10->0 over 360ms on the --out curve — and sections inside it do not animate separately. <Rise> is a plain wrapper that exists to mark those sections; it deliberately renders no animation of its own. The only nested motion allowed is a list stagger: stagger fires children 45ms apart with the rise variant, used on .rows.

dos: Do separate surfaces by stepping the tonal ramp (--surface -> --surface-low -> --surface-mid -> --surface-high -> --surface-bright), and reach for space before reaching for a second step.
Do give every screen exactly one .display line and at most one filled sage pill.
Do compose every fixed element with --safe-top / --safe-bottom and with --nav-h; the phone target has a punch-hole camera and gesture navigation.
Do wrap a screen in <Page> and let that be its only entrance animation; use stagger + rise only on a list of rows.
Do use .num on anything that ticks or counts — timers, streaks, minute totals — so digits do not jitter.
Do set secondary copy in --on-surface-2 (>=5.62:1 on every light surface, >=5.77:1 on every dark one) and reserve --on-surface-3 for 13px meta lines.
Do add new size variants to the coarse-pointer block if they are drawn under 44px; .pill-sm and .chip both already do this.
Do keep the sage accent under roughly a tenth of any screen. Its rarity is what makes the Start pill obvious.
donts: Don't add a border, a border-top, a divider rule or an <hr>. The system has none and the tonal step is the replacement.
Don't build a card grid, a KPI tile row, or any repeating boxed unit. Numbers are set as a sentence in a .headline; lists are borderless .rowitem rows.
Don't apply --shadow-float to anything that scrolls with the page. Shadow means fixed and floating — FAB, live pill, snackbar, rail FAB on hover.
Don't introduce a second breakpoint, a second font family, or a font weight above 500.
Don't uppercase or letterspace a label for emphasis; .section-title is sentence case at +0.01em and that is the ceiling.
Don't put --warm text on --surface-mid or --surface-high (4.32:1 / 4.01:1). Use --warm-container with --on-warm-container there.
Don't animate a section inside a <Page>. If something needs its own entrance, it is probably a new page.
Don't hardcode a hex in a component. Every colour in the build comes from a token so that both themes and the data-theme override keep working.
Don't stage a scripted multi-beat animation outside the onboarding welcome. One entrance, then the interface holds still.
